_comment: Dedicated risk blind-spot descriptions per leaf factor. Used by the Impact Analyzer to explain what risk area is unmonitored when a factor is excluded from evaluation. Separated from applicabilityRules naText which describes the exclusion reason, not the risk.

LF1.1.riskBlindSpot: Unverified manufacturing process capability — defective parts may reach production

LF1.2.riskBlindSpot: Equipment efficiency unknown — production bottleneck risk undetected

LF1.3.riskBlindSpot: Material grade/certification gap — non-conforming material may enter supply chain

LF1.4.riskBlindSpot: Tolerance capability unverified — dimensional non-conformance risk

LF1.5.riskBlindSpot: Special process qualification unknown — welding/heat-treat/plating quality unassured

LF1.6.riskBlindSpot: Engineering capability gap — design support and problem-solving capacity unknown

LF1.7.riskBlindSpot: No similar part track record — first-time production risk unquantified

LF1.8.riskBlindSpot: Industry experience unknown — domain-specific compliance knowledge unverified

LF2.1.riskBlindSpot: Installed capacity unknown — ability to meet volume requirements unconfirmed

LF2.2.riskBlindSpot: Available capacity headroom unknown — risk of allocation shortage

LF2.3.riskBlindSpot: Ramp-up capability unverified — launch delay risk during volume increase

LF2.4.riskBlindSpot: Customer concentration risk unmeasured — supplier dependency on single buyer unknown

LF2.5.riskBlindSpot: Peak demand flexibility unknown — surge/seasonal demand risk unaddressed

LF3.1.riskBlindSpot: QMS certification status unknown — systemic quality management gap

LF3.2.riskBlindSpot: SPC deployment unknown — in-process variation uncontrolled

LF3.3.riskBlindSpot: Measurement system capability unverified — inspection data reliability unknown

LF3.4.riskBlindSpot: CAPA closure performance unknown — recurring quality issues may persist

LF3.5.riskBlindSpot: Quality history (PPM) not assessed — defect trend and supplier track record invisible

LF3.6.riskBlindSpot: PPAP/launch readiness unknown — part approval status unconfirmed

LF4.1.riskBlindSpot: On-time delivery history unknown — supply disruption risk unquantified

LF4.2.riskBlindSpot: Lead time reliability unmeasured — planning buffer accuracy unknown

LF4.3.riskBlindSpot: Logistics capability gap — shipping/customs delay risk unaddressed

LF4.4.riskBlindSpot: Production scheduling adherence unknown — line-stop risk from poor planning

LF4.5.riskBlindSpot: Buffer/safety stock policy unknown — supply interruption resilience unverified

LF4.6.riskBlindSpot: Order flexibility unknown — inability to respond to demand changes

LF5.1.riskBlindSpot: Liquidity position unknown — supplier cash-flow risk unmonitored

LF5.2.riskBlindSpot: Leverage/solvency unknown — over-leveraged supplier risk invisible

LF5.3.riskBlindSpot: Profitability trend unknown — long-term viability risk unassessed

LF5.4.riskBlindSpot: Revenue scale unknown — size mismatch and dependency risk invisible

LF5.5.riskBlindSpot: Financial distress signals not screened — insolvency risk undetected

LF5.6.riskBlindSpot: Insurance coverage gap — liability exposure in case of incident

LF6.1.riskBlindSpot: Regulatory compliance unverified — legal/regulatory penalty exposure

LF6.2.riskBlindSpot: Trade compliance not screened — sanctions/export control violation risk

LF6.3.riskBlindSpot: Anti-bribery controls unknown — ABAC compliance gap

LF6.4.riskBlindSpot: ESG performance unknown — sustainability and reputational risk

LF6.5.riskBlindSpot: Data security/IP protection unverified — intellectual property leak risk

LF6.6.riskBlindSpot: Ethical sourcing status unknown — human rights and supply chain ethics risk

LF7.1.riskBlindSpot: Single-source concentration risk unmeasured — supply chain vulnerability

LF7.2.riskBlindSpot: Geopolitical risk not assessed — regional instability exposure unknown

LF7.3.riskBlindSpot: Sub-tier dependency unknown — hidden supply chain fragility

LF7.4.riskBlindSpot: Business continuity plan unknown — disaster recovery capability unverified

LF7.5.riskBlindSpot: Ownership stability unknown — M&A or distress-driven disruption risk

LF7.6.riskBlindSpot: Capacity redundancy unknown — no backup if primary site fails
